training.particle_image_encoder: Per-frame; context and dynamics combine temporal particle sequences.
training.context_inverse: Infers latent action using transition destination and preceding particle states.
training.context_prior: Predicts latent action without transition destination.

generation.rollout: Context prior and particle dynamics autoregression; optionally decode generated particles.
generation.special_context_replay: use_all_ctx=True obtains latent actions from the full supplied real sequence; separate from forecasting.

policy_paper.training: Frozen LPWM inverse latent actions from real video/action sequences supervise an action mapping transformer with L1.
policy_paper.deployment: Current observation and goal can initialize prior/dynamics rollout. Inverse module applied to generated particle trajectory feeds the action mapping; future real RGB is unavailable.

limitations: Preset frame counts are configuration values, not a universal LPWM requirement.
Sketchy generation/evaluation CLI may override cond_steps; README examples use six.
num_static_frames controls the static KL region, not inference observation count.
No training changes were made for this explanation.
